title: FRANK'S NEW PALACE JOB COMES WITH AN OLD ARSENAL CUP PROBLEM
description:
Bottom of the table, a deal to June 2029, and that cup photo.

Thomas Frank is Palace's new manager on a contract that runs to June 2029. Palace sit bottom, and he starts away at Coventry.

In January, as Spurs boss, he was photographed with an Arsenal cup. He had said drinking a rival's cup on purpose would be absolutely stupid.

Spurs sacked him in February, after under eight months. Some cups last longer.

Now he hopes not to be pictured with another rival's cup. Our advice for Coventry: a plain bottle.

Harmless photo or fair game for the banter? Which side are you on?
